title: Pretrained, Curriculum-Tuned, and Ensembled: A Tracer-Aware Interactive Segmentation Pipeline for AutoPET V
abstract: arXiv:2608.30844v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT requires a model to provide a strong initial prediction while also responding efficiently to sparse corrective scribbles during inference. This setting is particularly challenging because tracer distributions, physiological uptake patterns, lesion appearance, and acquisition characteristics differ substantially between FDG and PSMA studies. We present TRIAGE, Tracer-aware Refinement via Interactive Anatomy-Guided sEgmentation. The core backbone is a 3D STU-Net initialized through masked autoencoding pre-training with an asynchronous masking strategy, aiming to learn transferable anatomical and cross-modal representations before task-specific fine-tuning. In parallel, we train an auxiliary organ segmentation model whose predictions provide explicit anatomical context and help distinguish physiological uptake from malignant lesions. A dedicated tracer classifier first routes each study

translated_title: 预训练、课程微调与集成：面向AutoPET V的示踪剂感知交互式分割流水线
translated_abstract: 全身PET/CT中的交互式病灶分割要求模型既能提供强大的初始预测，又能在推理过程中高效响应稀疏的修正涂鸦标记。这一场景尤其具有挑战性，因为FDG与PSMA研究在示踪剂分布、生理摄取模式、病灶外观和采集特性方面存在显著差异。我们提出了TRIAGE（Tracer-aware Refinement via Interactive Anatomy-Guided sEgmentation，基于交互式解剖引导分割的示踪剂感知精化方法）。其核心骨干网络为3D STU-Net，通过采用异步掩码策略的掩码自编码预训练进行初始化，旨在任务特定微调之前学习可迁移的解剖学与跨模态表征。与此同时，我们训练了一个辅助器官分割模型，其预测结果提供显式的解剖学上下文，有助于区分生理性摄取与恶性病灶。一个专门的示踪剂分类器首先对每项研究进行路由……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TRIAGE交互式分割流水线，通过掩码自编码预训练的3D STU-Net骨干、辅助器官分割提供的解剖学上下文以及示踪剂分类器路由，实现针对FDG与PSMA两类示踪剂的全身PET/CT病灶精准交互式分割。
en_tdlr: TRIAGE is a tracer-aware interactive segmentation pipeline for whole-body PET/CT that combines a masked-autoencoding-pretrained 3D STU-Net backbone, auxiliary organ segmentation for anatomical context, and a tracer classifier to handle both FDG and PSMA studies.
